summary_markdown: The user initiated the process of reaggregating Brazilian data starting from July 1st into the STAGE dataset (offline sensors forecast). A new SQL script for ML to STAGE aggregation was shared. The plan is to develop a unified, configurable job within the week.
decisions: Brazilian data will be reaggregated into the STAGE dataset starting July 1st.
